```{r setup}
pkg_root <- params$pkg_path

if (!is.null(pkg_root) &&
    file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
    file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "R"))) {
  devtools::load_all(pkg_root)
} else {
  library(ReportR)
}

spec_path <- if (!is.null(params$spec_file) && file.exists(params$spec_file)) {
  params$spec_file
} else if (!is.null(pkg_root) && !is.null(params$spec_file)) {
  file.path(pkg_root, params$spec_file)
} else {
  NULL
}
if (!is.null(spec_path)) source(spec_path)

aggregate_results <- readRDS(params$results_file)
min_n             <- params$min_n
report_years       <- params$report_years
report_years_label <- if (is.null(report_years)) "all years" else paste(range(report_years), collapse = "–")

# Detect subject column name used in results
subj_col <- intersect(c("SUBJECT", "CONTENT_AREA"),
                       names(aggregate_results$performance_trends$school_level_summary))[1]

fmt_ft <- function(ft) {
  ft |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
}
```

## Introduction

```{r subtitle, results='asis'}
cat("###", assessment_spec$program$name, "\n")
```

This section presents school- and district-level findings for `r assessment_spec$program$name`. Analyses are organized into five areas: (1) performance trends, (2) demographic composition and population shifts, (3) outlier schools performing above or below demographic expectation, (4) within-school achievement gaps, and (5) rank-order stability. Cells with fewer than `r min_n` students are suppressed throughout.

```{r data-availability, results='asis'}
p <- aggregate_results$params
if (!isTRUE(p$school_results_available)) {
  cat("> **Note:** Sections 5.2 (Accountability Grade Distributions) and 5.7",
      "(Intervention Analysis) require `school_results_long` and are not shown",
      "in this report.\n")
}
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## School Performance Trends

### Improvement Classification

Schools are classified as **improving**, **stable**, or **declining** based on year-to-year change in percent proficient (threshold: ±`r aggregate_results$params$improvement_threshold` percentage points).

```{r tbl-improvement, tab.cap="School Improvement Classification by Year and Subject"}
imp <- aggregate_results$performance_trends$improvement_classification
if (!is.null(report_years) && !is.null(imp)) {
  imp <- imp |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] %in% report_years)
}

if (!is.null(imp) && nrow(imp) > 0) {
  tbl <- imp |>
    dplyr::count(.data[[subj_col]], YEAR, classification) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = classification, values_from = n,
                       values_fill = 0) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[subj_col]], YEAR)

  fmt_ft(flextable::flextable(tbl))
} else {
  cat("*Improvement classification data not available.*\n")
}
```

### School Proficiency Distribution by Year

```{r plot-proficiency-dist, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
school_tbl <- aggregate_results$performance_trends$school_level_summary
school_plot_data <- if (!is.null(school_tbl))
  school_tbl |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[["pct_proficient"]])) else data.frame()

if (nrow(school_plot_data) > 0) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    school_plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(x = factor(.data[["YEAR"]]), y = .data[["pct_proficient"]])
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(fill = "#9fc5e8", alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(stats::as.formula(paste("~", subj_col))) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of School Proficiency Rates —",
                    assessment_spec$program$short_name),
      x = "Year", y = "% Proficient"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
} else {
  cat("*School proficiency data not available.*\n")
}
```

### School-Level Regression Slopes

```{r plot-slopes, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
slopes <- aggregate_results$performance_trends$regression_slopes
slopes_plot <- if (!is.null(slopes) && "slope" %in% names(slopes))
  slopes |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[["slope"]])) else data.frame()

if (nrow(slopes_plot) > 0) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(slopes_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[["slope"]])) +
    ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#9fc5e8", color = "white") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#cc0000") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(stats::as.formula(paste("~", subj_col))) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Distribution of School-Level Proficiency Slopes",
      subtitle = "Positive = improving over time; negative = declining. Dashed line = zero.",
      x = "Slope (percentage points per year)", y = "Number of Schools"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()
} else {
  cat("*Regression slope data not available (schools may have fewer than 3 years of data).*\n")
}
```

### Year-to-Year Correlation Stability

```{r tbl-correlations, tab.cap="Year-to-Year Spearman Rank Correlations of School Proficiency"}
corr <- aggregate_results$stability$year_to_year_correlations

if (!is.null(corr) && nrow(corr) > 0) {
  display <- corr |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pearson_r  = round(.data[["pearson_r"]],  3),
      spearman_r = round(.data[["spearman_r"]], 3),
      flagged    = ifelse(.data[["flagged"]], "Yes", "")
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[subj_col]], .data[["year_pair"]])

  ft <- fmt_ft(flextable::flextable(display))

  # Highlight flagged rows
  flag_rows <- which(corr[["flagged"]])
  if (length(flag_rows) > 0) {
    ft <- flextable::bg(ft, i = flag_rows, bg = "#fce8b2", part = "body")
  }
  ft
} else {
  cat("*Correlation data not available.*\n")
}
```

## Demographic Composition and Population Shifts

### School Demographic Composition Over Time

```{r tbl-demo-composition, tab.cap="Mean School Demographic Composition by Year (% of students)"}
demo <- aggregate_results$population_shifts$school_demographic_composition
if (!is.null(report_years) && !is.null(demo)) {
  demo <- demo |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] %in% report_years)
}

if (!is.null(demo) && nrow(demo) > 0) {
  yr_order  <- sort(unique(demo$YEAR))
  stat_cols <- paste0(yr_order, "_pct")

  school_id_col <- intersect(c("SCHOOL_NUMBER", "SCHOOL_ID"), names(demo))[1]

  summary_tbl <- demo |>
    dplyr::filter(.data[["demo_val"]] %in% c("Yes", unique(demo$demo_val)[1])) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[["demo_var"]], .data[["YEAR"]]) |>
    dplyr::summarize(mean_pct = round(mean(.data[["pct"]], na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(col_name = paste0(YEAR, "_pct")) |>
    dplyr::select(-"YEAR") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col_name, values_from = mean_pct) |>
    dplyr::select(demo_var, dplyr::any_of(stat_cols))

  fmt_ft(
    flextable::flextable(summary_tbl) |>
      flextable::set_header_labels(demo_var = "Demographic Variable") |>
      flextable::add_footer_lines("Values are mean % across all schools.")  |>
      flextable::fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer")
  )
} else {
  cat("*Demographic composition data not available.*\n")
}
```

### Composition Shift vs. Proficiency Change

```{r plot-composition-proficiency, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
comp_prof <- aggregate_results$population_shifts$composition_proficiency_join

if (!is.null(comp_prof) && nrow(comp_prof) > 0) {
  delta_cols <- grep("^delta_", names(comp_prof), value = TRUE)
  if (length(delta_cols) > 0 && "yoy_change" %in% names(comp_prof)) {
    first_delta <- delta_cols[1]
    demo_label  <- sub("^delta_", "", sub("_pct$", "", first_delta))

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      comp_prof |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[first_delta]]),
                                  !is.na(.data[["yoy_change"]])),
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[first_delta]], y = .data[["yoy_change"]])
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.2, color = "#4472c4") +
      ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
                           se = TRUE, color = "#cc0000", linewidth = 0.8) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(stats::as.formula(paste("~", subj_col))) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title    = paste("Composition Shift vs. Proficiency Change —", demo_label),
        subtitle = "Each point = one school-year transition",
        x        = paste0("Year-over-Year Change in % ", demo_label),
        y        = "Year-over-Year Change in % Proficient"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw()
    print(p)
  }
} else {
  cat("*Composition-proficiency data not available.*\n")
}
```

## Outlier Schools

Schools are identified as performing **above** or **below** expectation using a residual model that regresses school proficiency on demographic composition. Schools with residuals exceeding ±`r aggregate_results$params$outlier_sd_threshold` standard deviations are flagged.

### Funnel Plot

```{r plot-funnel, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
funnel <- aggregate_results$outliers$funnel_plot_data

if (!is.null(funnel) && nrow(funnel) > 0) {
  school_id_col <- intersect(c("SCHOOL_NUMBER", "SCHOOL_ID",
                                "SCHOOL_NAME"), names(funnel))[1]
  subjs <- sort(unique(funnel[[subj_col]]))
  most_recent <- max(funnel$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    funnel |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] == most_recent),
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data[["n_tested"]], y = .data[["pct_proficient"]])
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = .data[["lower_99"]], ymax = .data[["upper_99"]]),
      fill = "#f4cccc", alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = .data[["lower_95"]], ymax = .data[["upper_95"]]),
      fill = "#fce8b2", alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      ggplot2::aes(yintercept = .data[["state_pct"]]),
      linetype = "solid", color = "#4472c4", linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "grey40") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(stats::as.formula(paste("~", subj_col)),
                        scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title    = paste("Funnel Plot — School Proficiency vs. Enrollment,",
                       most_recent),
      subtitle = "Shaded bands: 95% (yellow) and 99% (red) control limits. Blue line = state average.",
      x        = "Number of Students Tested",
      y        = "% Proficient"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()
  print(p)
} else {
  cat("*Funnel plot data not available.*\n")
}
```

### Above-Expectation Schools

```{r tbl-positive-outliers, tab.cap="Schools Performing Above Demographic Expectation (Most Recent Year)"}
pos <- aggregate_results$outliers$positive_outlier_schools

if (!is.null(pos) && nrow(pos) > 0) {
  most_recent <- max(pos$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE)
  display_cols <- intersect(
    c("SCHOOL_NAME", "DISTRICT_NAME", subj_col, "YEAR",
      "n_tested", "pct_proficient", "predicted_proficiency", "residual"),
    names(pos)
  )
  fmt_ft(
    flextable::flextable(
      pos |>
        dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] == most_recent) |>
        dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(display_cols)) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          pct_proficient        = round(.data[["pct_proficient"]], 1),
          predicted_proficiency = round(.data[["predicted_proficiency"]], 1),
          residual              = round(.data[["residual"]], 1)
        ) |>
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data[["residual"]])) |>
        head(30)
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("*No above-expectation schools identified.*\n")
}
```

### Below-Expectation Schools

```{r tbl-negative-outliers, tab.cap="Schools Performing Below Demographic Expectation (Most Recent Year)"}
neg <- aggregate_results$outliers$negative_outlier_schools

if (!is.null(neg) && nrow(neg) > 0) {

    c("SCHOOL_NAME", "DISTRICT_NAME", subj_col, "YEAR",

    names(neg)
  )

    flextable::flextable(

          pct_proficient        = round(.data[["pct_proficient"]], 1),
          predicted_proficiency = round(.data[["predicted_proficiency"]], 1),
          residual              = round(.data[["residual"]], 1)
        ) |>
        dplyr::arrange(.data[["residual"]]) |>
        head(30)
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("*No below-expectation schools identified.*\n")
}
```

### Persistent Outliers (2+ Years)

```{r tbl-outlier-stability, tab.cap="Schools Flagged as Outliers in Two or More Years"}
stab <- aggregate_results$outliers$outlier_stability

if (!is.null(stab) && nrow(stab) > 0) {
  display <- stab |>
    dplyr::filter(.data[["n_years_flagged"]] >= 2) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data[["n_years_flagged"]]),
                   dplyr::desc(abs(.data[["mean_residual"]])))
  if (nrow(display) > 0) {
    fmt_ft(flextable::flextable(display))
  } else {
    cat("*No schools flagged in 2+ years.*\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*Outlier stability data not available.*\n")
}
```

## Within-School Achievement Gaps

```{r tbl-gap-trends, tab.cap="Within-School Gap Trend Classification by Subject and Gap Pair"}
gap_class <- aggregate_results$disaggregated$gap_trend_classification

if (!is.null(gap_class) && nrow(gap_class) > 0) {
  summary_tbl <- gap_class |>
    dplyr::count(.data[[subj_col]], gap_pair, trend_direction) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = trend_direction, values_from = n,
                       values_fill = 0) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[subj_col]], gap_pair)

  fmt_ft(
    flextable::flextable(summary_tbl) |>
      flextable::set_header_labels(gap_pair = "Gap Pair") |>
      flextable::add_footer_lines(
        "narrowing = gap closing over time; widening = gap growing; stable = < 0.5 pp/yr change."
      ) |>
      flextable::fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer")
  )
} else {
  cat("*Gap trend classification not available.*\n")
}
```

```{r plot-gap-distribution, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
gaps <- aggregate_results$disaggregated$within_school_gaps

if (!is.null(gaps) && nrow(gaps) > 0 && "gap_estimate" %in% names(gaps)) {
  gap_pairs_avail <- sort(unique(gaps$gap_pair))
  for (gp in gap_pairs_avail[seq_len(min(2, length(gap_pairs_avail)))]) {
    gap_plot_data <- gaps |>
      dplyr::filter(.data[["gap_pair"]] == gp,
                    !is.na(.data[["gap_estimate"]]))
    if (nrow(gap_plot_data) == 0) next
    cat("\n\n####", gp, "\n\n")
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      gap_plot_data,
      ggplot2::aes(x = factor(.data[["YEAR"]]), y = .data[["gap_estimate"]])
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_boxplot(fill = "#9fc5e8", alpha = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#cc0000") +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(stats::as.formula(paste("~", subj_col))) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title    = paste("Within-School Gap:", gp),
        subtitle = "Positive = advantaged group outperforms; dashed line = no gap.",
        x = "Year", y = "Gap (percentage points)"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*Within-school gap data not available.*\n")
}
```

## Rank-Order Stability

```{r plot-icc-trends, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
icc <- aggregate_results$stability$icc_trends
icc_plot <- if (!is.null(icc) && "icc" %in% names(icc))
  icc |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[["icc"]])) else data.frame()

if (nrow(icc_plot) > 0) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    icc_plot,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data[["YEAR"]], y = .data[["icc"]],
                 color = .data[[subj_col]], group = .data[[subj_col]])
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title    = "Intraclass Correlations Over Time",
      subtitle = "Higher ICC = more variance between schools than within schools.",
      x = "Year", y = "ICC", color = "Subject"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()
} else {
  cat("*ICC trend data not available (requires lme4 package).*\n")
}
```

## District-Level Summary

```{r tbl-district-summary, tab.cap="District Proficiency Summary (Most Recent Year)"}
dist_tbl <- aggregate_results$performance_trends$district_level_summary
if (!is.null(report_years) && !is.null(dist_tbl)) {
  dist_tbl <- dist_tbl |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] %in% report_years)
}

if (!is.null(dist_tbl) && nrow(dist_tbl) > 0) {
  most_recent <- max(dist_tbl$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE)
  district_id_col <- intersect(c("DISTRICT_NUMBER", "DISTRICT_ID"), names(dist_tbl))[1]

  display <- dist_tbl |>
    dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] == most_recent,
                  !is.na(.data[["pct_proficient"]])) |>
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(
      intersect(c(district_id_col, "DISTRICT_NAME", subj_col), names(dist_tbl))
    ))) |>
    dplyr::summarize(
      # pct_proficient must be computed before N so that .data[["N"]] still
      # refers to the original per-row weight vector, not the scalar sum
      pct_proficient = round(stats::weighted.mean(
        .data[["pct_proficient"]], .data[["N"]], na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      N              = sum(.data[["N"]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[subj_col]], dplyr::desc(.data[["pct_proficient"]]))

  fmt_ft(flextable::flextable(display))
} else {
  cat("*District summary data not available.*\n")
}
```

## Sections Pending school_results_long

The following sections are planned but require `school_results_long`, which is not yet available:

- **5.2 Accountability Grade Distributions** — requires `ACCOUNTABILITY_GRADE`, `ACCOUNTABILITY_INDEX`, and indicator scores
- **5.4 Outlier Characterization** — requires `CO_OP`, `LOCALE`, `HQIM_FLAG`, `LITERACY_COACH_FLAG`
- **5.7 Intervention Analysis** — requires `HQIM_FLAG` and `LITERACY_COACH_FLAG` for propensity-matched comparisons

When `school_results_long` is available, rerun `run_aggregate_analysis()` with `school_results_long` provided and re-render this report.

# Appendix: Historical Data (All Years)

```{r appendix-note, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report_years)) {
  all_years  <- sort(unique(aggregate_results$performance_trends$improvement_classification$YEAR))
  hist_years <- setdiff(all_years, report_years)
  if (length(hist_years) > 0) {
    cat("*Main report sections above show data for", report_years_label, "only.",
        "Full data for all available years is exported to Excel.*\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("*No historical years outside the report window.*\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*All available years are shown in the main body.*\n\n")
}
```
